demo.footer: DjiHealth — demonstration prototype · LARAY Strategic Advisory

setup.title: Missing configuration
setup.body: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env.local (see README).

home.tagline: Your health record, with you everywhere in Djibouti.
home.privacy_body: All people and data in this demonstration are fictitious. Every time a record is opened, it is logged.

features.vault: A medical vault: conditions, allergies, medicines, vaccines, visits and documents.
features.emergency: An emergency card with a QR code that any phone can read.
features.maternal: Pregnancy follow-up and children's vaccination calendar.
features.ai: An AI summary and assistant that explain the record in simple words, never giving medical advice.
features.ministry: An anonymised dashboard for the Ministry.

signin.title: Demo accounts
signin.subtitle: Tap a profile to sign in.
signin.note: Fictitious accounts with a shared demo password. No real data.

fatouma.name: Fatouma
fatouma.desc: Patient, mother of a toddler (Djibouti City)

hassan.name: Dr Hassan
hassan.desc: Doctor — access with the patient's consent

vault.title: My record
vault.emergency_scanned_when: Viewed on {{when}}. If this was not an emergency, you can revoke the card.
vault.summary_teaser: Your record explained in simple words, in your language.
vault.access_teaser_one: {{count}} view of your record by someone else.
vault.access_teaser_other: {{count}} views of your record by other people.
vault.patient_reported_note: What you add will be marked "reported by the patient".

documents.upload_hint: Photo or PDF (lab result, prescription…). 10 MB maximum.

access.title: Access to my record
access.subtitle: Who viewed your record, when and why.

actions.emergency_access_denied: Attempt with a revoked or expired card

emergency.title: Emergency card
emergency.subtitle: In an emergency, a health worker scans this code with any phone.
emergency.card_a11y: Emergency card of {{name}}, blood group {{blood}}, with QR code
emergency.none: You don't have an emergency card on this device yet.
emergency.active_elsewhere: A card is active (created on another device). Create a new one here to display it: the old one will be revoked.
emergency.preview: See what the health worker sees
emergency.privacy_body: The QR code contains no medical data: only a link with a random secret code. You can revoke it at any time. Every scan is logged.

ev.title: Emergency information
ev.logged: This access is logged and reported to the patient.
ev.demo_note: DEMO — synthetic data. Do not use for real care.

maternal.title: Mother & child
maternal.empty: No pregnancy follow-up or children recorded.

risk.high: Close follow-up (classified high risk by the team)

maternal.planned_note: Upcoming visit. Measurements will be added by the professional.

children.title: My children
children.schedule_source: Indicative demonstration schedule, from the vaccination_schedule table. {{note}}
children.overdue_body: Mention it at your next visit to the health centre.
children.all_done: All vaccines planned so far are done.
children.no_reference: Reference curves to be added after validation

how.only_record: The AI only rephrases what is already in your record.
how.no_advice: It never gives a diagnosis or treatment advice.
how.deid: Your name, phone and date of birth are never sent to the AI.
how.validator: An automatic check blocks any summary that mentions something not in your record.

assistant.title: DjiHealth Assistant
assistant.subtitle: I help you find information in your record.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant gives no diagnosis or medical advice. It only answers with information from your record. In an emergency, call emergency services.

suggest.next_visit: When is my next antenatal visit?
suggest.child_vaccines: What is my child's next vaccine?
suggest.share: How do I share my record with a doctor?

assistant.error: The assistant is not available right now.
assistant.out_of_scope: Medical question: ask a health professional
assistant.blocked: Answer blocked by the safety check

share.title: Share my record
share.subtitle: Give a health professional temporary access.
share.explain: Show this code (or the QR) to the professional. It is valid for 24 hours and can be used once. You can withdraw access at any time.

clinician.title: Professional area
clinician.subtitle: Access to records with the patient's consent.
clinician.enter_code_hint: The patient creates a code in "Share my record".
clinician.reason_hint: Required. It is logged and visible to the patient.
clinician.camera_permission: The camera is only used to read the sharing code.
clinician.my_patients_hint: The list empties as soon as access expires or is withdrawn.
clinician.rls_note: Without valid consent, the database refuses access (row-level security), whatever the screen.
clinician.reason_required: State why you are opening this record. The reason is logged and visible to the patient.
clinician.no_access: Access refused (consent missing, expired or withdrawn)
clinician.saved_body: The patient sees it immediately, marked "entered by a professional".

ministry.title: National dashboard
ministry.subtitle: Aggregated, anonymised indicators.
ministry.synthetic_body: No real figures. Groups of fewer than 5 people are hidden ("< 5") to prevent re-identification.
ministry.anc_rule: Complete = at least {{n}} visits (value to be validated)
ministry.coverage_note: Children under 5 who have reached the age for the dose (+4 weeks). Indicative schedule to be validated.
ministry.footer: Groups smaller than {{min}} hidden. Generated on {{date}}.

admin.title: AI quality control
admin.subtitle: Drafts rejected by the validator.
admin.explain: These texts were never shown to patients. They are used to improve the AI instructions.

charts.tap_point: Tap a point to read its value.
